messages:
emma_csm: Heads-up: TidalWare token volume down ~62% over the last 10 days. Champion (Maya) left last week, procurement spun up a short pilot with RivetAI. Marking renewal-risk, need quick triage. :warning:
devin_sales: Thanks. Any clue if this is full migration or a test? do we have current active seats + trend? :eyes:
status_bot: Analytics: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/tidalware/usage (14d: -62% tokens, seats 10->3) :bar_chart:
rachel_eng: No serving errors in logs for the period. I do see increased 403s around SSO callbacks starting when Maya left. possible auth handoff issue.
noah_cs: I'll take outreach. Proposed play: 1) 20m enablement with new ML lead; 2) quick diagnostics + prompt sample request; 3) offer $3k promo credit for a 1-week Dedicated canary if they commit to enablement + exec sync.
devin_sales: I can approve the $3k credit contingent on a verbal commit during the enablement. Legal prefers credits.
noah_cs: Asking them to run a quick diagnostic and paste results here:
noah_cs: ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/tidalware/diagnostic \
  -d '{"sample_days":7}'
```
emma_csm: I'll email new contact (Marco L.) now and propose Tue/Wed 20m slots. target: get enablement + exec sync this week, then reassess renewal risk. :rocket:
